hook.name: SlipstreamAggregator
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that routes all swaps through a corresponding external Slipstream concentrated liquidity pool (identified by tickSpacing), returning a BeforeSwapDelta to cancel v4 pool execution. Liquidity provision via v4 is blocked; the hook acts as a pure bridge to the external CL protocol with an optional protocol fee taken on the unspecified swap side.
